protocol.holdoutStatus: Exploratory only; selection rationale, timestamp, and whether past changes used holdout results are undocumented.
protocol.holdoutMonthRationale: No contemporaneous rationale for February, April, September, and November was recorded; do not treat these scenarios as an untouched confirmatory holdout.
protocol.holdoutInfluenceHistory: Unknown; no auditable record establishes whether holdout information influenced labels, weights, penalties, or code changes.
protocol.parameterSelection: Weights and disruption penalties are design values; no independent tuning record is available.

aggregateScopes.overall: All 36 scenarios, including 12 mixed-pool scenarios; scenario-level K varies by pool.
aggregateScopes.categorySpecific: 24 waterfall and trekking scenarios only; excludes the mixed pool.
aggregateScopes.development: 24 scenarios across all three pools in months outside the designated holdout months.
aggregateScopes.holdout: 12 scenarios across all three pools in the designated holdout months; exploratory only.

evaluationConfig.undefinedNDCGPolicy: NDCG is null if there are no eligible recommendations, any original scenario candidate lacks a relevance label, or shared-pool IDCG is zero; the original candidate pool defines IDCG for every method.
evaluationConfig.precisionDenominatorPolicy: P@K is undefined if any original scenario candidate lacks a relevance label; otherwise divide relevant returned recommendations by effective K. Requested and effective K plus label coverage are reported.
evaluationConfig.closureConflictDefinition: Top-K destinations matching current evidence-backed full-destination closure records only. N/A includes a reason code distinguishing no eligible recommendations, no qualifying record, and insufficient evidence.
evaluationConfig.disruptionEvidenceCoverageDefinition: Per-scenario fraction of supplied disruption records matching a candidate destination and month, and either explicitly applying to the destination category or having unknown activity scope, that pass evidence, freshness, event-validity, scope, and trigger checks; known out-of-activity-scope records are excluded. N/A when no candidate-relevant records remain. Sub-destination geographic applicability is not represented by the current data.
evaluationConfig.rankingEligibilityPolicy: Each method is evaluated on its own eligible ranked list: missing required score inputs are excluded, and Method C also quarantines current evidence-backed full-destination closures. NDCG ideal rankings use the same original scenario candidate pool for all methods; exclusion counts and eligible pool sizes are reported by method.
evaluationConfig.holdoutStatus: Exploratory; selection rationale and historical independence from tuning are not established.

evidence.issuingAuthority: Uttarakhand Forest Department (Chamoli Division)
evidence.verificationNote: Mandatory annual winter closure from Nov 1 to May 31 confirmed by Uttarakhand Forest Department.
